name: Cybernex Networking
summary: Dialup + web hosting ISP (©1995-1998); homepage frozen at Aug 1998 yet served for a decade; domain rebuilt as a CMS site c. 2012-13 then reduced to a placeholder.

events.details: Dialup + web hosting; homepage carries "Copyright 1995-1998 by Cybernex Networking" (founding year unverified beyond that). Full ISP portal captured Dec 1997.
Homepage frozen at "last updated 21 August 1998" but kept serving unchanged through ~2009; domain rebuilt as a Joomla/Uvumi CMS site c. 2012-13, then reduced to a small placeholder page by 2014.
